# Dayton Audio ND25FW-4, vendor spec sheet

`nd25fw-4-spec-sheet.pdf` is Dayton Audio's spec sheet for the ND25FW-4
1" neodymium dome tweeter with integral waveguide faceplate, added here on
2026-08-21 (file retrieved 2026-07-01).

- sha256 `df07658442175e97eeb8dd613b5f2ae51f741d38e66ae807f1819cc7ba9a48e2`

Kept as the reference for the tweeter position: faceplate diameter,
mounting pattern and depth figures used when checking the printed baffle's
tweeter recess and pilot geometry trace back to this sheet.
